final: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT c.state_county_province AS state, COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM Accounts AS a JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), shares AS (SELECT state, customer_count, customer_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(customer_count) FROM state_counts) AS share FROM state_counts), above_average AS (SELECT customer_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares) AS difference FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM shares)) SELECT SUM(customer_count), AVG(share), AVG(difference) FROM above_average
